validity.recommendation: Verify/correct LengthKnown: sources put the EWPS-1 to EWPS-3 scope (MGS-3 Package 4, east-west gas pipelines 3 and 4) at 300 km, not the 150 km recorded. If P6720 is the full-route line 'four' (as its segment name implies), it should read ~300 km; GEM appears to have halved the 300 km package figure across the P6719/P6720 pair.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real and under construction. Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3), ~$10bn / 17 EPC packages / ~4,000 km, is heavily documented. Package 4 = 'laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-1 to EWPS-3', contractor Mapa (Turkey), named identically in MEED, Blackridge Research, and DMS Projects. Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: correct — a 56-inch Master Gas System trunk = gas transmission. FuelSource Gas correct. ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco 100% correct (Aramco's own Master Gas System). Endpoints EWPS-1 -> EWPS-3 (East-West Pipeline pump stations); both Saudi Arabia. DUPLICATE: P6719 is the paired sibling (same EWPS-1->EWPS-3 route). Segment name carries the line number '4', so P6720=east-west line 'four' and P6719=line 'three' — two PARALLEL physical lines along the same corridor, so NOT a true duplicate, but the pair should be checked together. SPEC — the flagged issue: every independent source gives 300 km for the EWPS-1->EWPS-3 Package 4 scope (MEED table 'EWPS-1 to EWPS-3 | 300', Blackridge '300km'); GEM records 150 km. Cross-checking siblings shows the same halving pattern (Pkg3 56km->P6717/P6718=28+28; Pkg5 166km->P6721/P6722=83+83; Pkg6 370km->P6723/P6724=185+185), while single-line packages 9-17 match their MEED figures exactly (458,310,462,116,470,212,192,52 km). Since the two lines run the SAME corridor (both named EWPS-1->EWPS-3), each line is the full ~300 km, not 150 — so the 150 km is very likely an undercount produced by splitting the package figure across the two parallel lines. No source states 150 km for anything on this route. Diameter 56 in is corroborated by all sources. Ambiguity remaining: if MEED's '300 km' were instead total pipe for both lines over a ~150 km route, 150 would be correct — but the per-station-gap lengths (one gap ~166 km for Pkg5) argue against a 150 km two-gap route, so I lean strongly that 150 is wrong.

fills.researcher_notes: Location [ref] was blank (only country=Saudi Arabia recorded). MEED Package 4 explicitly routes 'EWPS-1 to EWPS-3', so endpoints filled to the named pump stations. Province left blank (EWPS-3's admin region not independently confirmed — do not guess). Capacity left blank: the 3.15 bscfd figure is the whole-MGS-3 program add, not attributable to one segment.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status 'construction' confirmed. MGS-3 contractor awards made early/Q1 2024 (MEED, Mapa won Packages 4+9); construction commenced Q2 2024 with on-site activities underway by Jan 2025 (Blackridge); L&T/Qapqa completed a 120 km 56-inch section of sibling Package 8 by Sept 2025 and mobilized on a further 241 km (Pipeline Technology Journal) — the mainline 56-inch program is actively being built. No evidence of operation or of shelving; program completion targeted Q4 2028, matching the recorded StartYear1=2028. Most recent dated evidence: Sept 2025. Not stale (well under dormancy thresholds and clearly progressing).

summary: Real, correctly classified Aramco MGS-3 transmission line; status=construction confirmed (evidence Sep 2025, completion 2028); SPEC concern — LengthKnown 150 km vs sourced 300 km for the EWPS-1->EWPS-3 (Package 4) scope, likely a halving artifact.
